method_reasoning: Linux proc status FDSize reports allocated descriptor-table capacity, not an approximate count of open descriptors. Every descriptor index is bounded by that capacity; exact capacity0 establishes descriptorcount0 for that task.

A terminal Z/X task with all-zero statm, exact stable PID/startticks, and statusThreads1 has no live sibling thread retaining a different active table. Threads1 is additionally required before this supplemental route can establish closure.

EACCES or zombie state alone establishes no descriptor fact. StatusFDSize>0, absent/malformed/duplicate fields, identity changes, unsupported namespace/kernel, nonzero memory or Threads>1 must not produce a positive fallback.
